contexts.text: This was represented also by Leah and Rachel, the two wives of Jacob, of whom Leah represented the External Church, and Rachel the Internal... AC 1242:end.

The External (Jewish Church) was represented by Leah. But as Jacob, or his descendants... were such that they wanted nothing but external things... Leah was given to Jacob before Rachel; and by Leah the weak eyed was represented the Jewish Church; and by Rachel the New Church of the gentiles.
How the good of truth was conjoined with related good... first by the affection of external truth, which is Leah... Treated of.
The representation of Leah, that it is the affection of exterior truth. Explained. AC 3793:2.
The name of the elder was Leah () = the affection of external truth, with its quality.

Leah is called the elder, because external truth is said first... or, what is the same, man is first affected with external truths... for external truths are the planes of internal ones; for they are the generals into which the singulars are insinuated...
The eyes of Leah were weak () = the affection of external truth as to its affection, that it is such. Explained.
And he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him, and he came to her () = that the conjunction was as yet only with the affection of external truth. AC 3838.
Leah, who is here the first-born, = the affection of external truth.
He also loved Rachel above Leah () = the love of internal truth above external truth... Leah = external truth.
That Leah was hated () = that the affection of external truth was not so dear, because it was further from the Divine. Explained.
Leah conceived, and bare a son () = spiritual conception and birth from what is external to what is internal. Explained.
For by Leah is represented the affection of external truth.

In the preceding chapter, by the four sons of Jacob from Leah, it treated of the state of the Church, or of the man who is becoming a Church, as to the ascent from the truth which is of faith to the good which is of love. In this chapter, by the sons of Jacob from the handmaids of Rachel and Leah, and from Leah, and finally from Rachel, it treats of the conjunction of natural truth by media with spiritual good; and this in the order in which it takes place with the man who is being regenerated.
Leah = external truth. References. AC 3913.
The mediums on the side of the external man, are signified by the handmaids of Leah.
For by Leah, who here is my sister, is signified the affection of the external man.
Leah saw that she stood still from bearing () = that no other external truths were acknowledged. Leah = external truth.
He brought them to Leah his mother () = application to the affection of external truth.
His woman Leah = the affection of external truth.
Leah () = the affection of external truth. AC 4096. AC 4099. AC 4153.
He divided the children over to Leah () = the disposition of external truths under their own affection. Leah = the affection of exterior truth. AC 4345.
Then (are insinuated) the less general things, that is, the particular ones relatively, which here are Leah and her children...
The daughter of Leah, whom she bare to Jacob () = (the affection of all things of faith, and the Church thence) in externals; (for) Leah = the affection of external truth.
The sons of Leah () = external Divine goods and truths in their order. Leah = the affection of external truth.
The moon, here, = natural truth, because it is predicated of Leah... For by Leah is represented natural truth.
Leah = the affection of exterior truth. References.
These are the sons of Leah, which she bare to Jacobin Paddan-Aram () = that those (doctrinals) were from spiritual affection in the Natural, through the Knowledges of good and truth.
It has been shown me by experience how Leah represented the Jewish Church; and Rachel the new one...
Hence it was given to know why Leah is described as weak-eyed.

Jacob represents the Church as to truth; Leah and Rachel, the Church as to good; but Leah, the External Church; and Rachel, the Internal Church... and therefore the dudaim were given to Leah... but Leah gave them to Rachel. Explained.
Leah = the External Church, which is natural. AE 695:15.
